title: anthyllis vulneraria var. macrophylla
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria var. macrophylla, commonly known as the long-leaved kidney vetch or large-leaved kidney vetch, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are thought to be due to its ability to soothe and calm skin irritations, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and improve digestion. The bioactive constituents of Anthyllis vulneraria var. macrophylla include saponins, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
